title: Partition lint pipelines by package ownership; add dependency-stability scanner and release lightprobe
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: Our monolithic lint workflow has grown slow and noisy; small frontend or SDK changes often wait ~12-15 minutes for irrelevant lint shards, and dependency churn in lockfiles frequently triggers full CI runs and noisy alerts. This PR splits the lint matrix by package ownership, adds a lightweight dependency-stability scanner that surfaces transitive churn risk, and wires a ‘release lightprobe’ smoke job for release automation to validate runtime-critical paths quickly.

What this PR does (high level):
- Introduces a package ownership map and a partitioned lint workflow so only owners' lint/test shards run for small, ownership-scoped changes.
- Adds a dep-stability scanner job that computes a stability score for modified lockfiles / package manifests and uploads a small JSON artifact to the PR (used by release gating).
- Adds a release lightprobe job that runs a minimal end-to-end smoke script against a staging runtime to catch regressions that lint/unit tests miss.
- Updates developer docs and the devtooling Make targets to generate the owner map automatically from CODEOWNERS and manifest tags.

Design notes and tradeoffs:
- Partitioning approach: Owner-map driven partitioning keeps the job matrix small and stable. Default behavior falls back to 'global' shard when ownership cannot be determined. We opted for JSON-based owner map generated from CODEOWNERS to avoid duplicating metadata.
- Dep-stability scanner: conservative heuristics (major version bumps, new transitive hosts, binary-native deps) are used. The scanner is intentionally permissive and emits warnings rather than blocking; the release gating can be configured to escalate.
- Release lightprobe: a short (~45s) smoke script that validates basic model-serving flows and the token billing path. Runs only on release candidates or when the release pipeline opts into lightprobe.

Checklist: 
- [x] Partitioned lint workflow with owner-map lookup
- [x] dep-stability scanner implemented (Go small utility under tools/)
- [x] release lightprobe smoke script and workflow job
- [x] docs: CONTRIBUTING.md update + dev/owner-map README
- [x] tests for ownership heuristics + unit tests for the Go scanner
- [x] CI integration and artifact publishing for scanner results

Commits (summary):
- initial: add owner-map generator and partitioned-lint workflow
- tools: add dep-stability scanner (tools/dep-stability/main.go) + unit tests
- ci: add .github/workflows/dep-stability-scan.yaml and release-lightprobe.yaml
- scripts: add scripts/lightprobe-smoke.sh and Makefile targets for dev tooling
- docs: update CONTRIBUTING.md and add dev/owner-map/README.md
- fix: ownership lookup fallback and flake guard in scanner tests

Changed areas (high level):
- .github/workflows/partitioned-lint.yaml (new): matrix computed at runtime using owner-map artifact; fallback to full-lint when necessary
- .github/workflows/dep-stability-scan.yaml (new): run scanner for PRs touching lockfiles/manifests; uploads artifact to PR
- .github/workflows/release-lightprobe.yaml (new): opt-in smoke for release candidates + manual trigger
- tools/dep-stability/main.go (new): lightweight scanner that outputs stability-summary.json
- dev/owner-map/generate_owner_map.go (new): generator and tests that pull CODEOWNERS + manifest tags
- scripts/lightprobe-smoke.sh (new): minimal E2E smoke shell script used by release jobs
- CONTRIBUTING.md (updated): guidelines for owner tags and dev workflow
- Makefile (updated): new targets: make owner-map, make dep-scan-local
- pkg/ci/owner_map.json (new generated artifact placeholder)

Review conversation (highlights):
- Amit Patel (review): "Nice reduction in CI surface. A couple of questions: how do we ensure we don't gate critical cross-cutting infra changes behind an owner map? Also please add metrics to understand what % of PRs get fast feedback."
- Maya (author): "Added a fallback 'global' shard for any path touching infra/ci or top-level directories and an annotation to always run global-lint on PRs that modify .github or tools/. Also added a telemetry counter step that emits 'ci.fast_feedback.v1' metric; can be toggled off via env."
- Sofia Martins (review): "Dep scanner looks useful, but the heuristic for native deps flagged some false positives in my local run. Can we add an allowlist config?"
- Maya: "Added a small allowlist under tools/dep-stability/allowlist.yaml and a unit test for the previous false positive case. Marked the scanner job non-blocking by default. We can promote it to a hard gate after another 2 weeks of traffic."
- Lucas Rivera (approval): "Approach looks good; please squash the last nit fix commit and we can merge. Confirmed CI green after rerun."

CI summary and notable events: 
- matrix: lint-fast (targeted shards) — pass on first run for most shards
- lint-full (fallback global) — skipped for ownership-scoped PRs; ran once for infra-touching paths
- unit-tests — pass (2 reruns to stabilize a flaky db test; rerun successful)
- dep-stability-scan — pass, artifact uploaded (stability-summary.json)
- release-lightprobe — pass in staged run (manual trigger in test)
- e2e-nightly — not run for PRs
- Overall run: green after re-run of unit-tests; CI status set to pass and gating checks updated accordingly

Merge outcome: Squash-merged into main after approvals and green CI. Merge performed by Lucas Rivera. The squashed commit message includes a short summary and the most relevant checklist items.

How to validate locally (dev notes):
- make owner-map  # generates dev/owner-map/owner_map.json from CODEOWNERS
- go test ./tools/dep-stability -run TestScanner -v
- ./scripts/lightprobe-smoke.sh --local-staging  # runs minimal smoke against local dev runtime

Follow-ups and rollout plan: 
- Monitor ci.fast_feedback.v1 telemetry for 2 weeks; revert owner mappings causing excessive global falls back.
- Add a GitHub App hook to annotate PRs with stability-summary badges (UX follow-up).
- Consider promoting dep-stability-scan to blocking for lockfile PRs after 30 days if false positive rate < 5%.

Notes for on-call and SRE: The release lightprobe should be considered an additional safety net but not a replacement for full release smoke. The lightprobe will be gated by the same RBAC token used by the release pipeline; ensure the token has read-only access and the minimum required scopes.

References: Linear tickets ENG-4287 (partition lint rollout) and ENG-4300 (dep-stability scanner), internal doc dev/owner-map/README.md and tools/dep-stability/README.md.

release_notes: Partition lint by package ownership to speed feedback for small PRs; introduce a non-blocking dependency-stability scanner that uploads a stability-summary artifact; add an opt-in release lightprobe smoke test. No breaking changes.
notes: This PR is part of a larger effort to reduce PR feedback times and to detect dependency churn earlier in the pipeline. Monitor telemetry and dep scanner noise for 2-4 weeks before tightening gates.
